LLM-backed flows were intentionally skipped per main agent (budget cap). Backend smoke for non-LLM endpoints (/api/promo/meta, /api/promo/video?v=3, /api/auth/login) also passed.

critical_code_review_comments: MoodPicker, JadeAvatar, SaveActions are clean, small, single-purpose components with proper data-testid coverage — good test hygiene.
SaveActions conditional render (returns null when data is null/empty) is correctly placed in the component itself, so callers can drop <SaveActions data={result} /> unconditionally — clean API.
Print CSS uses both [data-print-hide] attribute and .mood-picker class — two layers of redundancy. SaveActions emits data-print-hide so it self-hides during print. Good.
V3 video served as default in /api/promo/meta (versions_available.v1/v2/v3 all true), confirming backwards-compat for v1/v2 URLs.

/api/promo/video does not respond to HEAD (returns 405). Not a bug for browser <video> playback (which uses GET with Range), but if anyone uses HEAD for healthcheck/size-probe it will fail. Consider allowing HEAD.
context_for_next_testing_agent: LLM endpoints (extract/qualify/outreach/triage/chat/playbook-run/prompts-run/lighthouse-apply/self-test deep) were SKIPPED due to Universal LLM Key budget cap — they return HTTP 500 'Budget has been exceeded'. When budget is restored, run /app/backend/tests/backend_test*.py to regress. Frontend new components (MoodPicker, JadeAvatar, JadeWorking, SaveActions) all have data-testid coverage. V3 promo reel is the active default and was confirmed working end-to-end (meta + video bytes + dashboard toggle).
rca of the issue: No issues found. All UX-revamp components render and behave per spec.
